dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge extending from the dorsal junction to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded apex with an obtuse morphological profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual, low-sloping convexity transition from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with high thickness-to-length ratio visible at the anterior terminus.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse inflection point (approx. 160-170 degrees) at the melon-rostrum junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, white circular punctate marks visible on the lateral flank and near the base of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast bimodal pigmentation pattern with a sharp diagonal boundary between black and white regions across the mid-flank.
